I replied to Ilse in a thread on her #north-team message. I said I'd note the tip as unverified, and that I couldn't confirm or rule out Linnea Merriwether as the main contact for the Hollybank rollout at Marrow Agrisupply. I suggested checking with the account owner before anyone relies on it.

I only looked where Ilse could look herself: #north-team (she posts there) and the shared account files. The channel has nothing on Marrow Agrisupply or Hollybank, and no account files showed up for me to read. I didn't use message search, which would have reached conversations she can't see.
